text:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — need to lock launch criteria for the tenant-pricing pilot. Customer requires clear SLA, region residency, and prewarm guarantees. Who can give capacity + cost?
Anita (Infra): We haven't finalized reserved pool sizing. For ~50 qps sustained we need 8 A100-equivalent slots reserved or a burst schedule. Rough cost +20%. Need commitment from product.
Jon (Eng Lead): +1 Anita. Also there's a runtime change for prefix / KV cache warming. @Sophie can you confirm effort?
Sophie (Runtime): We can add adaptive prewarm + prefix caching. Needs a canary flag and a small infra hook. A rough estimate: 3 dev days + 2 days for canary/metrics. Affected models: rn-7b, rn-13b.
Maya (Product): Customer wants <200ms p50 for short-chat intents and a replayable audit stream to meet compliance. Can this be met with the above plan?
Sophie (Runtime): For rn-7b on dedicated pool + prewarm + small batch sizes, yes. rn-13b might need quantized variant or stricter concurrency limits to hit 200ms. We'll need model-pin rollout.
Liam (Security): Audit stream requirement: logs must land in a KMS-backed storage (HSM for key ops preferred). Also need an updated threat model and design doc for the pilot.
Jon (Eng Lead): Oncall gets hit if prewarm fails or cache thrashes. Need alerts for prewarm_failures, cache_evictions, and p50_latency_spike. @deploy-bot can you generate an alert skeleton?
deploy-bot: Generated alert skeleton: prewarm_failures / cache_evictions / p50_latency_spike. Runbook stub: https://intra/runbooks/prewarm. Suggest threshold: p50 > 200ms sustained for 1m.
Carol (Solutions): Note the customer also mandated EU residency (eu-west). That means dedicated routing and separate capacity — likely +2 weeks and a regional SOW addendum.
Anita (Infra): EU pool is available but requires provisioning lead time and ops runbook for billing segregation. I'll need a PO or commit window to schedule.
Maya (Product): Action items: 1) Anita + Jon: capacity estimate + cost delta (EOD Thu). 2) Sophie: runtime prewarm PR + canary flags (ETA Tue). 3) Liam: audit/HSM checklist + threat model (Fri). 4) Carol: confirm residency contract language and SOW (Mon). 5) Jon: integrate alerts into oncall (EOD Fri). Owners?
Jon (Eng Lead): I'll own alerts + canary rollout plan. Anita owns pool provisioning. Sophie owns runtime changes. Liam owns security gating. Carol owns commercial/residency comms.
Sophie (Runtime): Quick technical note — int8 quantization reduces cost but needs generation-quality eval. Recommend A/B experiment on canary to validate output fidelity before full rollout.
Liam (Security): Also confirm key rotation cadence; customer's compliance wants 90d rotation. Will add to checklist.
Carol (Solutions): I'll draft the kickoff and provisional SOW and share with Maya by EOD Fri.
Maya (Product): OK — go/no-go decision target: next Wed. If any blockers arise, call them out in this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
